svg.title: Train/Inference hash table and ITA inference prototype bank workflow
svg.desc: Full editable native SVG reconstruction. Left half contains Train and Inference rows feeding an Image Encoder and Hash Head into a Hash Table, with a downward Update arrow and a New table. Right half contains Train and ITA Inference rows feeding Image Encoder and Projector blocks into a Prototype Bank, with update loops and CE marker. Symmetry basis: two side-by-side panels separated by a vertical divider; each panel is organized in two horizontal rows, with encoders centered between image inputs and memory-bank/table structures.

g.desc: Left panel inventory: top Train label, bird photograph, rightward arrow, trapezoid Image Encoder with flame, Hash Head, Hash Table title and matrix; lower Inference label, four image thumbnails, frozen Image Encoder with snowflakes, Hash Head, second hash table, update and new arrows.

Right panel inventory: upper Train image feeds encoder and train projector into Prototype Bank with class-error CE flame marker; lower ITA Inference image group feeds frozen encoder and frozen projector into bank update area. Prototype bank update paths are drawn with orthogonal arrows and dashed boundary marks.
